title: No repeated queries in a decision tree trace
statement: Let $T$ be a finite decision tree on $n$ coordinates, and let a process sample consist of an input $x\in\Omega^n$ and a trace equal to the sequence of coordinates queried by $T$ on $x$. Then no coordinate occurs more than once in the trace.
hypotheses_covered: $T$ is a finite alphabet decision tree on $n$ coordinates
The sample is a process sample for $T$
